fields.System.Title: TRF-3 — Destination side
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Take the transfer in at the receiving site, check it against what was sent, and get it into
storage.

Scope

In. Receipt against a dispatch, validation, partial receipt, putaway.

Out. Discrepancy investigation — that is [TRF-4](TRF-4-in-transit.md).

Design notes

Idempotency is critical here. A transfer receipt processed twice creates stock from
nothing, at a site that has no ASN to reconcile against. Enforce with a unique constraint on the
dispatch reference plus line.

A partial receipt leaves the balance in transit, not lost. The transfer stays open and the
outstanding quantity remains in VIRT-INTRANSIT until it either arrives or is investigated.

Reuse inbound putaway. Transferred stock is stock arriving at a dock; it goes through the
same suggestion and confirmation flow as any other receipt.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Transfer received twice | [doc 09 §9.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Partial receipt losing the outstanding balance | [doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Quantity mismatch auto-adjusted | [doc 09 §9.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
